answer: Every grade must carry a written rationale, a random subset of settled grades is re-examined by a fresh panel, and graders whose rationales correlate with the same flaw as their clones are linked and removed together, so a captured panel is detected by its own consistency. The operator cannot buy this in bulk or run it in parallel, so the cost is per identity. A farm supplies an echo template, produces a vault signature across its seats, and is caught by the basalt re-reading: the echo is what it buys, the vault is what it cannot hide, and the basalt is what it cannot argue with.
